dedupe_keys.name: bassins hydrographiques associes a l arrete cadre secheresse du puy de dome

description: Bassins hydrographiques associés à l'arrêté cadre secheresse du Puy de Dôme is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by propluvia.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Puy-de-Dôme watersheds where measures to limit or suspend water abstraction may apply. For each watershed, reference hydrometric stations are defined with threshold flows triggering measures to limit or suspend water withdrawals. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Watersheds associated with the framework decree dryness of Puy de Dôme" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include données ouvertes, secheresse. The listing shows 2021-04-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
